snippet.title: The Flash Video Game: Keystone City Art Test
snippet.description: This is early game footage from the unfinished Flash video game made by Bottlerocket Entertainment in 2008.  When our publisher Brash folded we were about 6 months into full production with about a year still to go on the game so please excuse the roughness of how it looks at this stage.  This video showcases an art sample that we put together for Keystone City. Whereas Central City was all steel and glass we wanted to show Keystone as being the city with a foot still in the past with it's buildings of brick and mortar and a more laid back way of life.  Enjoy!
